lead: Demi Moore is a widely followed American stage actor, born on 11 November 1962 in Roswell.
As of 2026, she is 63 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.

She is associated with work such as Ghost, Striptease and The Hunchback of Notre Dame and has been recognised with Theatre World Award and Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy.
The sections that follow break down Demi Moore's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Demi Moore — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Demi Moore was born on 11 November 1962 in Roswell, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Demi Gene Guynes at birth and is publicly known as Demi Moore.
Public records name her father, Charles Harmon and her mother, Virginia King.
She studied at Fairfax High School and Redondo Union High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Demi Moore — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists stage actor, musical theatre actor, film actor, television actor, voice actor and film producer as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Demi are Ghost, Striptease, The Hunchback of Notre Dame, A Few Good Men, Disclosure, G.I. Jane, The Substance, Feud, Landman and General Hospital.
